key_concepts.formula:
If A completes a piece of work in n days, A's 1-day work = 1/n.
If A's 1-day work is 1/n, A finishes the whole work in n days.

If A can do a work in x days and B in y days, together in 1 day they finish (1/x + 1/y) of the work.
Total time taken together = (x * y) / (x + y) days.

If A is k times as good a workman as B, then:
Ratio of work done by A and B in same time = k : 1.
Ratio of time taken by A and B for same work = 1 : k.
Wages are distributed among workers in the ratio of their daily work rates (or total work completed by each worker).
